ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Smell ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

2. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.

4. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

5. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.

6. B — newton (N)

7. B — Producers

8. A — 100 °C

9. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

12. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Smell ENVIRONMENT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Light ENVIRONMENT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care For; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Safety In; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
